scope: Freeze step 1 only: exact approved REFERENCE_ONLY delegated-interface amendment v2 against its exact frozen predecessor and exact approved, not-yet-frozen semantic-catalog proposal; no candidate or scientific result accepted
hash_policy: SHA-256 over exact file bytes; no CRLF/LF normalization; Git blob ID independently binds committed bytes
proposal_status_annotation_policy: Proposal-time review/status and task-boundary annotations are preserved byte-for-byte as historical provenance. This manifest records the subsequently authorized exact-byte amendment freeze; it does not edit the proposal, freeze the semantic catalog, alter normative rules, or authorize implementation.
normative_region_extraction_policy: Exact UTF-8 file bytes from the first byte of the identified heading immediately following LF through EOF, including the original final newline; exclude the preceding LF and pre-heading title/status metadata; no normalization

frozen_delegated_interface_predecessor.identity_policy: Exact frozen predecessor bytes and committed blob; not a moving filename or earlier approved-proposal identity

delegated_interface_predecessor_freeze_m.upstream_identity_binding: All predecessor scientific-authority identities and hash policies remain bound transitively by these exact freeze-manifest bytes and unchanged controlling authorities

approved_semantic_catalog_proposal.byte_change_policy: Renewed independent review and compatible amendment/catalog binding required; no automatic substitution

normative_precedence_boundary.controlling_amendment_provisions: Exact frozen amendment v2 section 1 exhaustive override table; sections 2-12 supply its enumerated representation/staging details

permitted_overrides_and_supplements.effect: Add exactly SCIENTIFIC_EVIDENCE to the record-role vocabulary; mandatory RID/schema/program/owning-row/stage/path/selector/type/provenance checks remain necessary; all existing roles and reference fields unchanged

Complete source-inventory representation consistently across the existing 120 training, 32 primary, 16 primitive-sanity and 16 structural-transfer programs; no source, slot, case-selection, scientific population, V3.5 eligible population or expected-row-count change

Exact V3.2 payload, internal scientific records, immutable pre-disposition context, shared-support/owner-proof/per-occurrence RO containers, deterministic ordering and four-bucket accounting; preserve 184 rows and RID("V3.2", [program_id])

Lossless representation/staging adapter into v2 V3.2 payload, shared support and per-occurrence certificates, including matching immutable per-program E1 PASS before RO admission and later mandatory consistency vetoes; no semantic admission-rule change

normative_precedence_boundary.shared_invocation_rule: E1 per-program prerequisite facts are sealed in memory before RO within one exact supervised E1/direct invocation already satisfying all D tool/execution/compiler/provenance sharing conditions; no physical E1-report reread or generic scientific-output input route
normative_precedence_boundary.all_scientific_semantics: Existing frozen scientific authorities remain controlling; the bound approved catalog proposal's semantics are preserved without treating the catalog as already frozen
normative_precedence_boundary.applicability: Prospective only; no retrospective candidate/result reinterpretation; compatible semantic-catalog freeze remains required before separately authorized implementation
normative_precedence_boundary.conflict_policy: Unlisted conflict or unrepresentable scientific finding blocks acceptance under applicable FAIL/UNRESOLVED rules and requires prospective review; no permissive adapter or semantic relaxation

freeze_order.review_prerequisite: Independent approval of the exact amendment v2 and exact approved semantic-catalog proposal bytes
freeze_order.step_1: Freeze amendment v2 against the exact frozen base delegated interface, its freeze manifest, and exact approved semantic-catalog PROPOSAL bytes; performed by this manifest only
freeze_order.step_2: After independent review of this completed amendment freeze and separate authorization, freeze the exact same semantic-catalog proposal bytes against frozen Coverage-v3 authority/freeze, exact base delegated interface/freeze, and this completed amendment/freeze identity
freeze_order.implementation_authorization_prerequisit: Both exact compatible freezes must exist and be independently verified, followed by separate explicit implementation authorization; no implementation between incompatible partial freezes

protected_integrity_at_freeze.verification_method: Read-only identity verification via verify_protected_inputs, plus exact approved-proposal/predecessor checks; no diagnostic report emitted

freeze_commit_identity: Git commit containing only this amendment freeze manifest; SHA reported after commit creation to avoid self-reference
